_note: LLM answer-quality eval set. Each item is a viewer question asked at cursor time t. The harness reconstructs the production active-Q&A context (spoiler-safe retrieve() knowledge + the current cursor-filtered scene slice), generates an answer with the real dialogue system prompt + model, then an LLM judge scores faithfulness / helpfulness / no-spoiler against that same context. Answers and judgments are cached; re-runs read the cache unless --refresh.
